label: Every world sees some world and the selected world does not see itself
paraphrase: Rival framework commitment, unattributed: accessibility is serial (every world accesses some world) and the selected world does not access itself. Replacement account: the relation is read as what lies ahead or what would be ideal, as in temporal-future or deontic readings, not as alethic possibility, so what is the case need not count as accessible. Stronger than the negation of actual reflexivity by the seriality conjunct.
